title: Thai Chicken Salad
description: A refreshing Thai-inspired salad made with crispy chicken and crunchy vegetables. Serve immediately to enjoy the best flavors.

ingredients.name: crisp vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as carrots, bell peppers, and cucumbers

instructions: Grill or bake the chicken breast until cooked through, reaching an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).
Chop the cooked chicken into bite-sized pieces.
In a large bowl, combine the crisp lettuce, crisp vegetables, and chopped cilantro.
In a small bowl, whisk together the tangy Italian dressing and grated ginger.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
Add the chopped chicken to the salad and toss again to coat.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
